source_locator.edition_or_translation: Wisdomlib-hosted Michael D. Neely English translation (2007)
source_locator.short_quote: Those are to be ascertained by it abiding with the lord of the navamsha

prerequisites: Lagna or Moon or Sun reference
calculation_dependencies: ayanamsha requirement not specified in cited passage; external coordinate policy

reference_points: tenth lord/reference from Lagna, Moon, or Sun

normalized_rule: Brihat Jataka directs the vocation judgment to consider the navamsha lord together with the tenth lord/reference from the Lagna, Moon, or Sun, but the translated syntax is incomplete.
synthesis_notes: This is a Brihat Jataka/Varahamihira rule, not a universal Jyotisha claim or a scientific statement.
review_notes: This preserves the governing 10.1 dependency without inventing a modern D9 lord-of-action implementation.
transmission_notes: The cited Wisdomlib page attributes the English rendering to Michael D. Neely (2007) and is copyrighted reference material. The passage does not establish a universal ayanamsha; coordinate and ayanamsha policy remain external inputs.
